_comment: Vendor data for the machine checks. `competitor_domains`: hosts that a guide never links to; a Sources entry gives such a page as plain text (host and path, no link). check_guide.py adds the vendor hosts of the job's own evidence.vendors.md to this list. `aliases`: publisher name of a Sources entry (lower case) -> the name the ranking table uses for the same vendor, for vendors whose legal or former name differs from the brand; order_sources.py uses it to find the first use of a plain-text vendor source. The entries are fictional examples.
